annotations.title: Restore a server's world from a backup

description: Replaces the whole world with the chosen backup. No backup of the current world is taken, so everything since that backup is lost unless you run createBackup first. An asleep server restores at once; an online server applies it at the next restartServer or restartToApplySettings, and until then cancelBackupRestore undoes it. A different backupId replaces a queued restore.

serverId.description: Server id: the id field from listServers.
